notes: Libretto by Lorenzo Da Ponte (1786). Words follow the engraving's spelling (quì, sò, gia without accent in m. 102, È for E 'and' in 'È nol desti', finir la for finirla, vedo, stasera, invan, pria, de', com', c'intendi, all', un', nol, desir, compir). IPA follows sung Italian conventions: stressed syllable marked, elisions (two words on one note in the score) joined with ‿, open e/o as ɛ/ɔ, intervocalic s voiced (difesa with [z]; stasera and consolate with [s]), nasal assimilation across words (nom ˈmen.to, noɱ ˈvɛ, ˈbɛŋ ke); 'È' is sung as unstressed e, oibò as ojˈbɔ, and all'usanza with doubled l. Translation literal, for meaning.
